description: Capabilities for the desktop pet corner toast stack (passive notifications at a screen corner). All window mutation (show/hide/position/size) goes through custom `pet_corner_*` invoke commands which bypass the ACL, so no `core:window:*` perms are needed here. The corner toast only needs event access: `listen` for `pet://corner-show` (render stack + TTL) and `emit` for `pet://bubble-action` (card/action click → main window routes the jump, reusing the bubble's action channel).
